'''2011 Luxembourg Regionals Floris de Vries DS Death Star II: Throne Room''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Floris de Vries]] at [[2011 Luxembourg Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' According To My Design
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
